subject: Demo invite shows wrong organizer / guests can't join
messages:
From: Alex Moreno <alex@medicore.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 21 May 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Can't join today's demo — organizer appears as unknown

Hi Sofia,

Trying to join the 10:00am demo you scheduled but I'm getting a permissions error in Meet: 'You need permission from the organizer to join'. The calendar invite shows the organizer as 'morgan.ops@redwood.ai' (I don't recognize that address). Attendees at our end are blocked. Can you check?

I attached a screenshot of the error and forwarded the calendar invite. We still want the demo today — can we get an alternate link while you investigate?

Thanks,
Alex
Principal IT, MediCore
(alex@medicore.com)

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.ai>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 21 May 2025 09:25:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Can't join today's demo — organizer appears as unknown

Hi Alex — sorry about this.

On Wed, May 21, 2025 at 9:12 AM Alex Moreno <alex@medicore.com> wrote:
> Trying to join the 10:00am demo you scheduled but I'm getting a permissions error in Meet...

Ben — can you please confirm whether the invite was created under a shared scheduling alias or proxy? Laura, could you check the ics metadata (organizer field) and reissue a clean invite if needed?

Short-term: I'm attaching a one-click Zoom meeting link below that we can use as a fallback for the 10am — please use that if you still can't join via Google Meet. We'll get the calendar fixed and send an updated invite.

Zoom (fallback): https://zoom.us/j/999888777?pwd=demo-fallback

I'll keep you updated. Apologies for the interruption.

— Sofia
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sofia@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0143
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 21 May 2025 09:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Can't join today's demo — organizer appears as unknown

Sofia / Laura — I created the invite quickly via the sales scheduling tool (scheduling@redwood.ai) on behalf of the team. Looks like the tool set the organizer header to our ops mailbox (morgan.ops@redwood.ai) which is why MediCore's GSuite is rejecting the join attempt for external guests.

Action plan:
- Laura, please regenerate the ICS from my calendar so the organizer is the true host (sofia@redwood.ai) and resend to mediCore. Include a short note instructing guests to accept the updated event.
- If recreating fails, I'll create a new calendar event directly from my account and paste the Meet link there.

Also: we should avoid scheduling via scheduling@redwood.ai for external-facing demos unless organizer field is forced to the AE. I'll file a follow-up with ops.

Ben
Senior Sales Rep | Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.ai

Attachments referenced: invite.ics (regenerated stub)
From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Alex Moreno <alex@medicore.com>
Date: Wed, 21 May 2025 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Updated invite and note — please accept

Hi Alex — I've regenerated the calendar entry with the organizer set to Sofia (sofia@redwood.ai) and reissued the invite to your group. You should have a new event in your calendar titled 'Redwood product demo — MediCore' for 10:00am PT.

If you still see the permission error, please click the Zoom fallback link Sofia shared and we will proceed on Zoom.

Laura Bennett
Solutions Ops | Redwood Inference
laura@redwood.ai

Thanks everyone — confirmed the updated calendar entry came through and I was able to join the Meet link without the permission error. The demo went well and the stakeholders appreciated the backup Zoom link.

Two quick follow-ups: please attach the slide deck and the one-pager you mentioned. Also curious if we can avoid the scheduling alias for future external invites — it caused a short delay that looked messy to our IT folks.

Appreciate the fast turn-around.

Best,
Alex
